newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Editorials - July 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Editorials - July 11.

text.p: These are highlights of comments in the Hong Kong press. The views expressed are those of the newspapers quoted and do not represent an editorial viewpoint of Reuters.

-- The HONG KONG ECONOMIC JOURNAL said the provisional legislature was a product of political confrontation and lacked a sound legal basis. If its legality was judged inadequate by the courts, the political impact would be huge. The paper said it would be interesting to see how the court will choose between political reality and legal principles.

-- The Beijing-funded TA KUNG PAO said the Preparatory Committee that helped handle Hong Kong's reversion, whose task would end today, had made important contributions to the Chinese nation. It said both Hong Kong and mainland members of the Committee had gathered a lot of experience in working together, and the group had set a good example for future cooperation.

-- The English-language HONG KONG STANDARD said that while it was still too early to judge the performance of Chief Executive Tung Chee-hwa, it hoped that with the passage of time, he would be able to study his policies more thoroughly and co-ordinate them more effectively. It said Tung should make the necessary adjustment from businessman to politican.
